name: cost-aware-llm-pipeline
title: cost-aware-llm-pipeline
description: Model routing by task complexity, immutable budget tracking, retry logic and prompt caching composed into one pipeline pattern for LLM-API products.
why: There was no LLM-spend engineering skill at all — Ponytail cuts code tokens and workers-profiling is Worker performance. This matches the owner's credit discipline and his bots' multi-model fallback chains.
